## Sales by Customer

Income by customer over a period: the lines on income accounts, grouped by the customer of the sale they came from, largest first. It takes the cash basis and a comparison with the previous period or year.

```ts
import { SalesByCustomer, SalesByItem, ExpensesByVendor, GeneralLedger, PostingsReport } from '@cardstack/catalog/cards/accounting/ledger-report-library';
```

### Example
`Reports/sales-by-customer-2026`, the second half of 2026 against the first.
